Council Meeting - November 02, 2026
1.
Call to Order and National Anthem
Mayor Siscoe called the meeting to order in the Council Chambers at 6:00 p.m.
2.
Land Acknowledgement
Councillor Dodge read the following Land Acknowledgment:
The land on which Council meets today is the traditional territory of the Haudenosaunee, Anishinaabe, Attiwonderonk and the Mississaugas of the Credit First Nation peoples, many of whom continue to live and work here today. This territory is covered by the Upper Canada Treaties and is within the land protected by the Dish with One Spoon Wampum agreement. Today this gathering place is home to many Indigenous peoples, made up of First Nation, Inuit and Metis. The Dish with One Spoon Wampum agreement should remind us of our responsibility to ensure the Dish, the territories on which we live and work, is never emptied, and that we take care of the land and its inhabitants in a way that ensures its future sustainability.
